meta.name: Hard-to-cite real-web corpus
meta.selection_method: Hand-curated across verticals where AI answer engines rarely cite the primary source: government and civic portals, universities and research institutes, NGOs, D2C and hospitality brands (image-heavy), healthcare providers, local-services marketplaces (JS-heavy), long-tail B2B and industry bodies, and modern SPA product sites. Domains are over-provisioned; the capture tool skips whatever is dead, blocked or robots-disallowed and reports coverage.
meta.caveats: Curated from prior knowledge, so some domains will be dead, renamed or bot-protected. The capture report lists every exclusion with its reason, and the corpus manifest records exactly what was audited.
